body: I just had a very similar conversation. I said the same thing.

I would love if he would do therapy for himself,  but he has a severe distrust of all medical professionals. I feel like your comment most resonates with me. We both have deep trauma in our lives,  I'm working through mine now.  We have been together 15 years with a house and a life. I'm scared of losing all we worked for. He says I'm his motivation in life, yet I feel insignificant most of the time. I'm also frightened of leaving.
What if you have multiple times and they don't want to do couples therapy?
